title: Challenge Accepted
cn: 第 24 集 · 接受挑战
novel: Robin and Barney [[bonded|bond]] over their shared mission to [[intervene|intervene]] in Ted's relationship with Zoey. They believed that Ted was making a mistake and that Zoey was not the right woman for him. Robin and Barney spent hours [[plotting|plot]] ways to break them up, but every plan [[backfired|backfire]]. Their shared mission brought them closer together, and old feelings started to [[resurface|resurface]]. Meanwhile, Marshall became [[terrified|terrify]] that he had food poisoning after eating a bad sandwich from a street vendor. He [[rushed|rush]] to the hospital and demanded to see a doctor immediately. Lily tried to [[calm|calm]] him down, but Marshall was [[convinced|convince]] that he was dying. He wrote a [[will|will]] on a napkin and gave it to Lily, who could not stop laughing. The doctor eventually examined Marshall and told him that he just had a mild [[stomach|stomach]] ache. He would be fine after some rest. Marshall felt [[embarrassed|embarrass]] but also [[relieved|relief]]. Ted was supposed to perform his Best Man duties at Punchy's wedding in Cleveland. He had been [[practicing|practice]] his speech for weeks and wanted everything to be perfect. However, the wedding turned into a [[disaster|disaster]] when Punchy's relatives started a massive food fight. Ted's carefully prepared speech was completely [[ruined|ruin]], but he managed to improvise and gave a [[heartfelt|heartfelt]] toast that brought the room to tears. Meanwhile, Lily called Marshall with some [[incredible|incredible]] news. She was finally pregnant. Marshall burst into tears of joy right there in the hospital waiting room. He ran through the halls shouting the news to everyone he met. Robin and Barney, who had been growing closer all day, shared a [[passionate|passionate]] kiss. They realized that their feelings for each other had never truly gone away. Ted returned from the wedding exhausted but satisfied. He had accepted every challenge that came his way. The season ended with the gang together at MacLaren's, toasting to the future and all the [[challenges|challenge]] it would bring.

bond.en: to form a close relationship with someone

intervene.en: to get involved in a situation to help

plot.en: to secretly plan to do something

backfire.en: to have the opposite result of what you wanted

resurface.en: to come back to the surface or mind again

terrify.en: to make someone feel extremely afraid

rush.en: to move or do something very quickly

calm.en: to make someone feel less worried or upset

convince.en: to make someone believe something is true

will.en: a legal document about what happens after death

stomach.en: the organ where food is digested

relief.en: a feeling of comfort after worry ends

practice.en: to do something repeatedly to improve

disaster.en: a sudden event that causes great damage

ruin.en: to damage something so badly it is destroyed

incredible.en: impossible or very hard to believe

passionate.en: showing very strong emotion or desire

challenge.en: a difficult task that tests your abilities
